title: Chat Limiter
description: This plugin adds a time limit on how often players can send messages on chat.
body:
### **Chat Limiter**

## Features
- Slow down the frequency of sending messages on chat
- Permissions and bypass
- Fully configurable
- Low server impact

##   Commands
- /chatlimiter <on/off/reload>

##   Config
> enabled: true
cooldown-seconds: 10

> messages:
wait: "&cWait {time}s before sending another message."
